field_descriptions.child_taxon: Closest child taxa of the taxon in question.
field_descriptions.has_defined_term: A Defined Term contained in this term set.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.parent_taxon: Closest parent taxon of the taxon in question.
field_descriptions.taxon_rank: The taxonomic rank of this taxon given preferably as a URI from a controlled vocabulary – typically the ranks from TDWG TaxonRank ontology or equivalent Wikidata URIs.
